Hi — diving in on the ledger. Quick summary and ask:

Proposed approach (high level):
- Create a "tenant ledger" CSV that maps each CAIQ control to: the control statement we assert, the evidence type (artifact, runtime log, attestation), owner, and the pointer (Drive link / sample filename).
- For tenant-scoped runtime telemetry we're going to sample:
  • API request traces (7 days) — filtered to tenant ID
  • KV-prefix cache entries and eviction logs (3 days) — sample capture
  • Key usage audit from KMS (rotation timestamps + operator access)
- Residency / PII: all artifacts will be filtered to remove customer payloads; logs will be redacted where required.

Draft schedule:
Week 1: owner walk-through + artifact extraction (owners: infra-logs, keystore team)
Week 2: sample curation and delivery to secure share, follow-up validation session with OrionPay security.

What I need from OrionPay:
- Confirmation of the tenant ID(s) in scope
- Any additional control sub-elements they want included in the ledger (e.g., runtime sampling windows longer than 7 days)

I've started a ledger template and a sample manifest attached — will iterate once we get scope confirmation.
